title: Law to pilot matching small businesses with social media creators
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a one-year pilot program matching small businesses with social media content creators for marketing help. The agency would conduct outreach, create applications for both groups, notify matches within 30 days of enrollment closing, and report results to the mayor and Council Speaker after the program ends. The program must start within 180 days of the law taking effect and the law expires three years after enactment.
